recent_decisions.title: Do not make TTS add a main neural editing task
recent_decisions.summary: TTS add can be handled by TTS + traditional mixing; the neural editor focuses on remove/replace/local rewriting.
consequences: TTS event can be a normal event for remove/replace
Add-only TTS is a DSP baseline

recent_decisions.title: Use unified edit-program formulation
recent_decisions.summary: Treat text-to-audio generation as add edits from silence, and reference editing as local semantic rewriting.
consequences: Use base_audio + edits as the user-level schema
